title: Reporter Raju
overview: Raju is a daring and idealistic newspaper reporter who unexpectedly finds himself at the center of a deadly conspiracy. While working on a story, he encounters a dying nurse who reveals a sinister plot to assassinate a wealthy prince. Before Raju can alert the authorities, he is framed for the nurse's murder, forcing him to go on the run from the police. Evading capture, Raju must use his investigative skills to track down the true conspirators, clear his name, and stop the assassination before it is too late.
